rows.reaction: Back to the six-day week. I want to see whether talking leaves a trace this time.
Five orders again; I remember batching them last time and want to see the deadlines.
I pressed Go to the bakery and waited; I still appear in my room. I do not know whether the walk started.
Second press started the walk. The swap now says it is a prank with exchanged crosswords and a possible witness. That answers what it is; I will deliver properly.

Hacer is familiar from last visit: flat 1 and the newspaper order. Confident it is the same named neighbour, not necessarily the same circumstances. The panel now says I do not know her feeling or trust.

Five bakery orders with close first deadlines. Hacer received hers; I chose to sit and heard about her niece. Her panel says I do not know her feeling or trust. The swap now explains the prank. I want to see whether sitting changes what I can learn.
It now explicitly says the reply wording does not change her choice. That answers my old question, though it makes the two replies less of a decision.
Same leave-it-there answer as before. Checking whether the notebook moved.

The notebook explains 0 of 16 counts facts that reached it, and explicitly says it does not show feelings or trust. I heard a story but the count is still zero. I do not know what makes a story reach it.
Anything new gave a specific claim about Tarik and says I added a notebook line. That is a visible result. I want to check it.
Now 1 of 16: the notebook says Tarik would give me his last lemon candy. The count moved, though Hacer only said he is kind. I can see a result, but not what the story or reply did for Sunday.
Sevim at flat 2 is familiar from the previous newspaper order; confident in the name, not the new run. Testing a second sit.
Sevim says she would rather we left it there: slightly different words, same outcome as Hacer. The game told me my reply wording would not change her choice, so I believe that explanation.
The tell buttons now identify each item and explain that false certainty can cost trust. I will pass on the water notice marked sure.
I have answered my return question enough for tonight: the notebook moves for news, but two sits ended similarly and feelings stay unknown. I do not want to work through six days for the vote now.

Stopping desktop at Monday 08:07. The notebook moved after news, but I do not want six days of similar replies to reach the vote tonight. I selected stopping in Feedback and closed it without typing or submitting.
Second device, fresh week. I know the notebook can move from asking for news now.
Phone building and order fit. Tarik is first due here, unlike desktop; I will try his route.
Tarik has no news today, unlike Hacer on desktop. A repeat of the question is not automatically another notebook fact.
Same evening and the phone repeats the route I just learned. Tarik has no news; I do not want to repeat the week here.
